How to Charge Your Car Using the Exploren App
 
Step 1:
If the charger has a cable, simply plug it into your car.
If there’s no cable, use your own: plug it into the charger first, then connect it to your car. Note the port number you used.
Step 2:
In the Exploren app, tap the QR code button at the bottom right.
Step 3:
Scan the QR code on the sticker near your charging port.
Step 4:
Read the charger info, then tap “Start Charging.”
Step 5:
When you want to stop, open the app and tap “Stop Charging.”
